brief:
Actress Susan Sarandon told Al Jazeera English that she continues to lose acting work because of her public support for Palestine. The veteran performer said she has faced professional consequences tied to her advocacy on the issue, which has drawn scrutiny from industry figures and others.

Sarandon's remarks reflect broader tensions within Hollywood over pro-Palestinian speech and activism. Her experience highlights the real career risks that some entertainment industry figures encounter when they speak publicly on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. The issue has become increasingly contentious in recent years, with some figures facing backlash or reduced opportunities after taking positions on the matter.

title: Sarandon says Palestine support costs her film roles
